t2.thesis: ANET enters earnings after a sharp ~21% one-month drawdown with high expected volatility, so the reaction is near a coin flip, with a slight tilt up from a depressed base, strong estimate revisions and the historically positive hit rate for the cluster.
reasons: Stock down 21% in 1m and 24% off 52w high, a low bar into the print
EPS estimates revised up ~18% over 90 days, so the bar is higher on numbers, but guidance has been beating
Implied move ~9.9% with IV over 2x realized vol means a large, symmetric-ish outcome
Recent prints mixed (2 of 4 up); gross margin and memory costs are the swing risk
t2.deciding_variable: Q4 revenue guidance and gross margin trajectory (memory cost pressure) versus elevated expectations.

prior.from: I3 hardware_networking cluster hit rate 0.586, blended with overall 0.54 and AMC 0.538; ~0.56

theses.expected: Rise: beat and raise with Q4 guide above consensus relaxes the selloff
theses.mechanism: Depressed positioning and strong AI networking demand lead to a relief rally

theses.expected: Fall: margin compression from memory costs overshadows revenue beat
theses.mechanism: Stock priced for perfection on operating leverage; the headlines flag margin guidance
theses.wrong_if: Gross margin holds around 63% or better and guide implies stable operating margin

theses.expected: Flat or choppy: sector sentiment from AMD/SMCI same-day prints dominates the open
theses.mechanism: Correlated AI infrastructure reports the same evening shift the gap direction
theses.wrong_if: ANET-specific numbers clearly diverge from peers
